name: CLI runner
description: The `afterglow` executable (AfterGlowCLI/main.swift: hands the arguments, stdout and stderr to CLI.run and exits with its code) and the router in AfterGlowCLICore: CLI.run, CLI.version and the sysexits codes (CLI.Exit), with the parser, output, file system and app registry files the single-shot forms use. CL-1 makes `--version` live (one JSON object, sorted keys, exit 0); every other form exits 69 naming the slice that builds it until CL-2 and CL-4 fill them.
